natives.loaderOrder: Whisper.net looks in runtimes\<runtime>\win-x64 (vulkan) and runtimes\win-x64 (the CPU runtime) under the app folder.

vcRuntime.finding: The whisper natives import the Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 runtime (MSVCP140, VCRUNTIME140, VCRUNTIME140_1 and the OpenMP runtime VCOMP140). The self-contained app does NOT carry it and does not need it itself: coreclr.dll, hostpolicy.dll, Marrow.App.exe, libSkiaSharp.dll, libHarfBuzzSharp.dll and av_libglesv2.dll import only the Windows Universal CRT (api-ms-win-crt-*) or nothing. On a PC without the redistributable the voice natives fail to load. This PC has all four DLLs in System32. Not changed in this unit: either Velopack gets its vcredist143-x64 prerequisite or the four DLLs are shipped app-local; both are installer or packaging decisions that need the owner (V-3.2). Item F of BUILD-PLAN section 4 (Windows Sandbox) settles it on a clean PC.
vcRuntime.vulkanDriverDll: vulkan-1.dll is imported by ggml-vulkan-whisper.dll and comes from the GPU driver, not from the app.

cuda.offeredWhy: ENGINEERING DECISION (VT-0): the CUDA 12 pack is the one proven to load from a downloaded folder with NVIDIA 12.4 libraries beside it on the owner PC; the CUDA 13 pack is recorded but could not be tried (this PC has no cuBLAS 13).

feasibility.libraryPathNote: RuntimeOptions.LibraryPath is read through Path.GetDirectoryName: set it to a file path (any name) inside the download root, e.g. <root>\runtime.dll; the loader then searches <root>\runtimes\<runtime>\win-x64 (cuda12, cuda, vulkan) and <root>\runtimes\win-x64 (CPU). Passing the folder or whisper.dll itself finds nothing: the search root becomes its parent.
feasibility.order: RuntimeOptions.RuntimeLibraryOrder = [Cuda12, Vulkan, Cpu] (names of Whisper.net.LibraryLoader.RuntimeLibrary); a CUDA runtime that cannot load (the NVIDIA libraries missing) is skipped when a later runtime is listed, and throws "Failed to load native whisper library" when it is the only one.
feasibility.packDoesNotCarryNote: The pack holds whisper and ggml natives only. ggml-cuda-whisper.dll imports cudart64_12.dll and cublas64_12.dll (which needs cublasLt64_12.dll) from the NVIDIA CUDA runtime, and nvcuda.dll from the driver. The owner PC has no CUDA toolkit; the probe worked only with NVIDIA 12.4 copies (100,033,536 + 473,551,360 + 553,984 bytes unpacked) from the benchmark folder placed in the same runtimes folder.
feasibility.probe: Scratch console on the owner PC, 2026-10-04: with LibraryPath set and natives laid out as above, RuntimeOptions.LoadedLibrary read Cpu, Vulkan and Cuda12 for the three orders, each loading the Silero VAD model (WhisperVadFactory, UseGpu on) and finding the same two speech segments; with the three NVIDIA libraries removed, order [Cuda12] failed and [Cuda12, Cpu] loaded Cpu. Not measured: inference speed on CUDA (BENCH holds the whisper.cpp figures; BUILD-PLAN section 4 item D measures it through Whisper.net).
